name: exploded-v60-pareto-26.10-preview-s3-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a V60 pour-over dripper on its glass server, as an SVG. Use the cone dripper with a paper filter rather than a metal mesh filter.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="900" height="1250" viewBox="0 0 900 1250">
<defs>
 <linearGradient id="paper" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#e5d5b5"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#fff0d3"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#d9c7a5"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="ceramic" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#d8d8d1"/><stop offset=".3" stop-color="#fffef9"/><stop offset=".75" stop-color="#eeede6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#c5c9c4"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="inside" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#d8dcd4"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a7b4ad"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" x2="1"><stop stop-color="#c9dfe0" stop-opacity=".7"/><stop offset=".3" stop-color="#faffff" stop-opacity=".45"/><stop offset=".7" stop-color="#e0efed" stop-opacity=".3"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a9cecf" stop-opacity=".65"/></linearGradient>

 </g>

  <text x="62" y="593">Ribbed ceramic cone</text><text x="62" y="612">Single drain opening</text>
  <text x="62" y="975">Heat-resistant glass</text><text x="62" y="994">Pouring lip + handle</text>
 </g>
 <g stroke="#98a49a" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
  <path d="M208 292H303L361 286"/><path d="M208 566H280L321 589"/><path d="M208 949H273L323 966"/>

 </g>

 <text x="842" y="1195" text-anchor="end" font-size="11" fill="#778277">SCHEMATIC · NOT TO SCALE</text>
